inputs.text: This account turns a complicated public-safety question into a political attack on immigrants and local officials, without showing that sanctuary policies caused the danger or that federal enforcement was the only answer. If someone posed a risk, that should be addressed through fair, evidence-based public-safety measures—not by treating immigrant status as proof of threat or using the case to justify broader enforcement. Protecting people means accountability and safety for everyone, alongside due process and policies that don’t scapegoat vulnerable communities.
